_note: One row per fixed card. A card does not go to Done without a row. 'check' must fail on the pre-fix commit (proof in 'fails_on'); 'journey' is the audit/journeys file and check line that walks it in the browser.

_schema.check: tests/ or bin/ script, or journey check id
_schema.fails_on: commit where the check was shown red
_schema.now_dead_or_duplicate: code removed in the same change, or 'none'

escapes.class: a status change reuses another status's message instead of owning its own
